breve: Class representing a square mesh facing the camera.
descricao: Class representing a square PrimitiveMesh. This flat mesh does not have a thickness. By default, this mesh is aligned on the X and Y axes; this rotation is more suited for use with billboarded materials. A QuadMesh is equivalent to a PlaneMesh except its default 'PlaneMesh.orientation' is 'PlaneMesh.FACE_Z'.
